verdict.rationale: Cerebras has a dedicated rate-limits docs page that describes an uncached TPM limit and how prompt caching affects it. Its pricing page says paid self-serve gets "10x higher rate limits than free tier," which gives a coarse sense of how limits scale across tiers. missing for 10: actual per-model RPM/TPM figures for each tier, documented limits for higher tiers (enterprise/dedicated), and independent corroboration that the documented numbers match production behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and how they scale across usage tiers before I hit them in production

citations.quote: Cached tokens don't count toward your uncached TPM limit, so a higher cache hit rate lets you process far more total tokens within the same uncached limit.
10x higher rate limits than free tier
Self-serve payment starting at just $10 * 10x higher rate limits than free tier * Higher priority processing
